description: Punti Fiduciali di Pavia is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartografia.servizirl.it. The map contains 1174 trust points on 138 municipalities in the province of Pavia. These are the trigonometric points used to transfer cadastral cartography into the WGS 84 geographic reference system. The relief follows the Agreement with the Revenue Agency (AED) approved by DGR X/426 of 19/07/2013. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Pavia’s Trust Points" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include punti, catasto, gps, fiduciali, pavia, agenzia entrate. The listing shows 2014-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
